intro.text: A scholar and the author of Mythica, which studies what is known of the Unmade.

items.text: Hessi wrote Mythica recently, in Jasnah's time; it was poorly received and is hard to find. She knew some of its claims, such as that the Unmade still live and that Moelach causes Death Rattles, would be controversial. Shallan told Adolin and Kaladin about several of her ideas.
